guide.relicweave.mob.glassroot_stalker: Crystal shimmers in the wilds hide it. It warns before it strikes; watch for the shiver.
guide.relicweave.mob.ruin_hound: Fight with your back to a wall; hounds flank. Lone, wounded hounds flee and return.
guide.relicweave.mob.aether_grazer: Harmless. Shear it for Aether Down; the fleece regrows slowly. Sprinting scares it.
guide.relicweave.mob.shardback_brute: Dodge the slam ring and charge line. After a charge it is exposed: hit its back.
guide.relicweave.mob.starfall_strider: Do not stand in its flame trail. Sidestep the dash, then hit it while it turns.
guide.relicweave.mob.gravity_leech: Break line of sight to stop its pull; Gravity Shear protection weakens it.
guide.relicweave.mob.archive_mimic: A chest with seams and a violet keyhole is suspect. Strike first from range.
